checks.test: Asymmetric torque-free rotation conserves world angular momentum and rotational energy
Rotational midpoint integration shows second-order step-size convergence
10 s ground rest: four contacts, no translation or rotational drift
1 s free fall follows gravity without hidden altitude or attitude forces
Motor acceleration, friction-limited braking and steering turn the actual body
Bench-fed hover tracks height, translates and returns to a low-speed hold
Ceiling pressure holds for 10 s, permits tire-driven movement, then releases
Suction requires a nearby supporting surface: no magnetic capture in free air
Finite gas consumption equals summed nozzle impulse divided by effective exhaust velocity
Exhausted gas removes all thrust; prolonged finite hover loses support
A full roll is a six-DOF actuator maneuver with inversion, ballistic descent and recovery
180° arch traversal continuously climbs from ground and stops upside down
Mode takeover, non-finite input guards and scenario resets remain finite
Normal test runs reject a hidden recovery instead of accepting a shortened simulation
Collision geometry exposes every static collider, including arch and boundaries
Released accelerator coasts with mild regeneration instead of hidden hard braking
Valve output has finite rise and decay, and consumed gas follows delivered force
Adiabatic blowdown cools the tank and has lower pressure than the equal-mass isothermal case
After a roll, hover does not retain opposing side jets in the allocator null space
Finite-tank automatic roll remains airborne, recovers low and lands before fuel loses support
Twenty-Hz telemetry is uniform at 30, 60 and 144 display frames per second
Power exhaustion removes motor, fan and jet authority even with an external gas supply
A slow altitude integral rejects a constant unmodelled vertical load without pose correction
CSV schema contains quaternion, gas temperature and both nozzle command and delivered force
World-space exhaust preserves force sign and does not attach old gas to a moving vehicle
Mist emission count is frame-rate independent and rear outlets share one actuator force
